name: ossify
description: Experimental OpenCode opt-in for a skeleton-first lifecycle from Release 0 through MVP and v1. The v0.x engine, six entry skills, and close ceremonies are packaged through the root bundle's explicit allowlist; /ossify:run-spine drives a planned spine's rounds, /ossify:doctor diagnoses state, spec, rules, interop and budgets, and the any-repo utilities /ossify:handoff + /ossify:handoff-resume (session handoff) and /ossify:work-pr (review-fix-merge loop) round out the set. Outside stable marketplaces until Plan D's eval and pilot gate.
